title: I created an an DND DM solo practice web app with AI bots and AI coach
author: Competitive-Ice5620
selftext:
\*\*Its called The World Architect. It aims to help writers, authors, game devs, DND players and DMs\*\*    
\*\*Main features:\*\*    
\*\*- AI DND DM practice with AI bots and coach in your own world or AI generated one\*\*    
\*\*- Categorization and organization of world\*\*    
\*\*- Creating entities like: Characters, Monsters, Locations, Items, Materials, Factions etc.\*\*     
\*\*- 3D model upload to entities with 3d viewer\*\*     
\*\*- Automatic creation of Character sheets\*\*    
\*\*- visual relationship maps\*\*     
\*\*- interactive map maker\*\*    
\*\*- built in map creator (cartography tool)\*\*    
\*\*- timeline system\*\*    
\*\*- family tree system\*\*     
\*\*- node based Quest creator with dialogue system and unlimited choices and outcome options\*\*    
\*\*- creative writer with AI grammar checker and AI suggestor\*\*    
\*\*- AI world debugger to check for conflicts of information\*\*    
\*\*- DND session tool with Dice and Oracle system\*\*    
\*\*- AI solo DND adventure in your own or AI generated world\*\*

\*\*everything interconnected\*\* 

\*\*Free version and Paid version with 14 days free trial available\*\*

I am also gathering feedback, so feel free to write to me inside the page to further develop and better the Web app. 

\*\*Hope you will check it out and give it a try.\*\*
